question: 控制板灯不亮（适配器）No Led On the Control Board · Batteries and AC Adapter Nothing Works · Board Has Power Arms Won't Move
content_zh:
症状：换板后执行器直供电可行但远程/端子无输出 · replaced control board · actuator direct 24V power works both directions · clicking sound remote · fuse good click sound actuator doesn't respond 2 years old · board has power won't send power to arm terminals · DLMT COM ULMT tripped · proper terminals no response A3 A5 A8；非push remote 3 times·非must press remote multiple times·非CODE LED微微亮 only

症状：完全不工作/无反应/电机无输出（batteries and AC adapter · not getting anything to work · motor won't function · zero power to motor · lock still unlocks · worked four days · ET24 UPS01 · board has power arms won't move；非CODE LED微微亮·非push remote 3 times·非opens too far limit）
症状：完全不工作/无反应（batteries and AC adapter · not getting anything to work · nothing works · board has power won't send power to arm terminals · arms won't open or close · lights blink click；非CODE LED微微亮·非太阳能板单独故障·非gate arm warranty replacement）
症状：完全不工作/无反应（batteries and AC adapter · not getting anything to work · nothing works · board has power won't send power to arm terminals · arms won't open or close · lights blink click；非CODE LED微微亮·非太阳能板单独故障）
1 检查接线，测控制板BAT端口的电压
2 如果电压正常，检查控制板power灯是否正常闪烁，如果没亮，检查更换保险丝
3 如果电压低于22VDC，断开电池和控制板之间的接线，测量电池电压是否正常，如果低，测TS24-U适配器的输出，如果输出正常，多充一会儿试试；
4 如果电池电压还是不行，检查电池，更换电池试试
content_en:
Check all the wires are connected as they should be. And please measure the voltage of the +BAT- terminals (11# and 12#) on the control board to see whether it is above 22V.
If the voltage is normal, please check whether the power led on the control board is ON (blinks twice per second). If it is off, check the fuse whether it was burnt out and replace the fuse if necessary. There is a backup fuse packed within the user manual pack. The fuse type is ∅5*20mm 5A 250VAC fast blow glass fuse.
If the voltage is below 22V, please check whether the output voltage of the adapter is 36VDC. If so, disconnect the batteries from the control board and measure the output voltage of the batteries to see whether it is above DC 22V. If the voltage of the batteries is also below 22V, please keep the batteries charged fully to try it again.
If it still cannot work, please check the batteries. Kindly note that A 24V 12Ah battery (or 2pcs 12V batteries connected in series may function as 24V) is required to power the gate opener. Marine or Automotive type battery is compatible.

3 If there is still no luck, please release the clutches on the arm and push the gate to the middle position firstly. And engage the clutches and press the remote to see whether the gate can run towards the both directions. If it still doesn’t help, please go on the troubleshooting below.

If the motor runs in both directions, the motor itself is good. Please connect the black & red wires back to the control board and check step4.

content_zh:
1 检查端口接的线与线之间是否有铜丝触碰到，确认保险丝规格对的；
2 断开控制板端口上的有线配件，机臂线，只保留电源接线，然后按遥控器；
如果保险丝烧，检查控制板的输入电压，正常电压24VDC左右；如果电压没问题，那就是控制板坏，可以看看控制板表面是否有元器件短路痕迹；
(2) 如果保险丝不烧，把机臂从门上拿下来，机臂电机线接回控制板，打开离合，按遥控器看看烧不烧，此时如果烧，问题在电机电流大，如果不烧，合上离合再按遥控器，如果烧，问题在机臂内部卡顿，手动推拉机臂是否顺畅；
3如果没问题，把机臂装门上再按遥控器试试，如果这个时候烧 说明负载过大，可能门本身较重或卡顿，需要检查门本身是否可以推拉顺畅，并问问门宽门重；
4如果以上都好的，依次把有线配件接回去，逐一排查哪个配件导致烧控制板的。
content_en:
1 Verify no exposed copper strands are causing contact between wires at terminals. Confirm the fuse rating is correct (∅5*20mm 5A 250VAC fast blow glass fuse).
2 Disconnect all wired accessories and the gate arm from the control board, leaving only the power supply connected. Press the remote to test.
If the fuse blows, measure the input voltage to the control board. The normal voltage should be around 24V DC. If the voltage is correct, the control board is likely faulty. Inspect the board surface for any signs of component short circuits. If the voltage is incorrect, check the power supply.
If the fuse does not blow: Remove the arm from the gate and reconnect the motor wires to the control board. Disengage the clutch and press the remote.
If the fuse blows, the motor is drawing excessive current.
If it does not blow, re-engage the clutch and press the remote again.
If it now blows, the internal mechanism of the arm is jammed. Check if the arm moves smoothly manually.
3 If the arm tests fine off the gate, reinstall it to the gate and operate it via remote.
If the fuse blows now, this indicates excessive load, likely due to a heavy or obstructed gate. Use the release key to disengage the clutch of the arm, and check whether the gate itself can be manually opened & closed freely 3.3 feet (one meter) away from the gate hinge. If not, please let me know the weight and length of your gate and double check the gate to make sure the gate can run freely by hand.
4 If there is no problem after above steps, the problem lies in the wired accessories. Reconnect the accessories one at a time to identify the specific cause.

question: 电机电流小的原因
embedding_text:
电机电流小的原因
The operating current drawn by the gate arm motor is below the minimum detection threshold of the control board. This low current draw, which can occur with gates that are too light for the opener, causes the board to erroneously interpret the motor status and cut power prematurely, resulting in immediate stoppage.
Insufficient load (a gate that is too light) causes the motor current to fall below the control board's detection threshold, triggering an immediate safety shutdown.

2 Please check the power LED light condition. If the POWER LED is OFF, please check if the fuse has blown, and replace the fuse if necessary. There is a backup fuse packed within the user manual pack.
3 If the fuse is fine, please disconnect all wired accessories from the control board (just leave the power source and the arm). Disable the photocell function by turning the DIP switch #3 OFF. And try to press the remote to see whether the opener can work. If this step cannot help, please do step 4.

If not so, please check the motor as below.
4 Connect the red & black wires of the arm to the DC 24V power source directly, the motor should run, and then exchange the polarity of the wires, the motor should run in the opposite direction. If the motor runs in both directions at the normal speed, the motor itself is good.
5 Please let me know the result one by one. Videos showing the problem are much appreciated for further judgement. You can directly send the video to my E-mail via the attachment.
